remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home in University Villas, Fullerton, CA, offering nearly 2,000 square feet of living space on a large lot. With its combination of spacious living areas, modern updates, inviting outdoor space, and convenient location, this Fullerton home offers the space and lifestyle today's buyers are looking for. Freshly painted inside and out with new landscaping, this traditional-style home is move-in ready while still offering plenty of room to make it your own.
